description: This Python source file defines a CSV parsing service for extracting specific columns from CSV data and classifying string values as either TOPIC or LINK entities. It includes functions for reading CSV content from bytes, optionally considering headers, and for classifying values based on simple heuristics.

methods.name: List[str] parse_csv_content( csv_bytes: bytes, column_name: Optional[str] = None, has_header: bool = True, encoding: str = "utf-8", )
methods.description: Parses CSV bytes to extract a list of values from a specified column, with support for headers and encoding options.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] classify_source(value: str)
methods.description: Classifies a string value as either TOPIC or LINK based on simple heuristics, such as URL pattern and presence of 'wikipedia.org'.
